assignment_weights: LandmarkRiskSet with the logged tier and the accepted regime assignment (location = tier logit + gain * effective skill, sigma from the regime)
comparison: differences to the earlier CaLA gold v2 on the same players are documented (gold v2 used its own play loop, np.argmin and read a non-existent bootstrap key)
curves: causal_queries.compare_engine_curves / bootstrap_engine_curves (500 whole-player draws) / comparison_report; optimum via select_grid_optimum (shared tie rule)
description: Corrected logged-level engine reference (second stage, separate from the primary cloned-population benchmark). Built from original simulator primitives only; never mixed with the primary tables.
name: logged_gold_v3
off_grid_policy: players with logged |E| > 2 are included and flagged (per-level share reported)
opening: explicit initialisation from the logged attempt-20 step-0 state (board_before, specials_before, moves_left, goal colour) through the original sample_S0(value=State), goals_left = 10000 (quota-invariant full-budget game, the original threshold protocol)
outcome: goal_total >= calibrate.goal_count_for_E(level, e) at every grid point; completion margins from the cumulative goal profile exactly as causal_queries.engine_outcome_surface
play_loop: original scm._sample_action_decision -> sample_S_next -> sample_R with the full State (board + specials); one full-budget game per replicate
population: players of the held-out test split with a logged attempt 20 (active_before = 1), at their logged level and tier; both regimes separately
privileged_inputs: oracle/attempts.csv (skill k_*, mastery_before at attempt 20) - read only under --audit; outputs live under runs/engine_reference/logged_level/ and never feed learner code
quota_collisions: reported per level from calibrate.goal_count_for_E; not patched
rollout_seeds: base = SeedSequence([seed, player_id, 20]); replicate r -> SeedSequence([base, r]) (the original engine_outcome_surface rule)
version_note: logged-gold v3; v1 ignored stripes, v2 propagated stripes in a separate implementation
replicate_rule: The final paper reference uses R128; precision checks are reported at all available doublings, not assumed to pass.
